rooms.1: A small, bare room aboard an alien spacecraft: smooth riveted white-and-blue metal panels, soft cold light, a closed-in, futuristic cell.
rooms.2: A metal room aboard an alien spacecraft: a control console of glowing buttons, a large smooth plastic block on the floor, and a large radiant glowing neon tube sign on the wall made of abstract curving shapes (no letters).
rooms.3: A long metal-lined tunnel aboard an alien spacecraft in strong one-point perspective: ribbed white and deep-blue curved wall panels, a black ceiling with bright white light strips, a white floor converging to a small glowing magenta hatch at the far end.
rooms.4: A metal room aboard an alien spacecraft, white and blue riveted panels, an opening on one side, cold futuristic light.
rooms.8: A metal room aboard an alien spacecraft used for hydroponics: racks of lush green plants growing under violet grow lights, and a tall glass display case standing empty against the wall.
rooms.10: A metal room aboard an alien spacecraft with a blinking red light mounted above a shimmering doorway in the far wall.
rooms.11: A gymnasium aboard an alien spacecraft: a treadmill, a large medicine ball, a freestanding punching bag and a small control console, on a gleaming metal floor.
rooms.12: A red metal room aboard an alien spacecraft, walls of glossy red panels, a control console glowing against one wall.
rooms.13: A red metal room aboard an alien spacecraft, walls of glossy red riveted panels, bare and softly lit.
rooms.14: A cramped metal area aboard an alien spacecraft: low ceiling, pipes and ducts pressing in, barely room to stand.
rooms.15: A metal storage hold aboard an alien spacecraft: giant boxes and crates stacked high, rows of glass display cases, and a pulsating red force field glowing across the back.
rooms.16: Standing on a long red treadmill belt aboard an alien spacecraft, the belt running away from the viewer between metal railings, white walls and a blue ceiling.
rooms.17: Looking out from inside an open glass display case aboard an alien spacecraft: the glass frame around the view, a single glowing button on the inside of the case, a metal room beyond.
rooms.20: The main control room of an alien spacecraft: a wide curved control console of glowing lights and switches below a huge viewscreen showing stars and deep space.
rooms.22: A small metal cabin aboard an alien spacecraft with a single soft padded sleeping platform, a small plastic wafer lying on it, cosy cold light.
rooms.23: A metal dormitory aboard an alien spacecraft: rows of soft red padded sleeping platforms either side of a grey aisle, large cyan wall panels behind.
rooms.24: A metal lifeboat hangar aboard an alien spacecraft, open to outer space: a large hexagonal hatch frame in the floor or wall, and through a huge opening the black of space with stars and a blue-green planet.
rooms.26: A large metal room aboard an alien spacecraft full of humming machinery: pipes, cylinders and panels, with a control console in front.
rooms.27: A large metal room aboard an alien spacecraft filled with strange machinery made of glossy white porcelain: curved bowl shapes, smooth pedestals and a small domed device, under cold light.
rooms.30: Death: a doomed scene aboard an alien spacecraft — red alarm light flooding a metal corridor, a skull on the floor, ominous and final.
